concept: Vintage-premium barbershop: navy-charcoal ink and deep navy on warm cream, anchored by a confident barber-red primary with a restrained brass accent for timeless, masculine polish.
contrastNotes: All pairings verified against #F7F2E9 bg (rel. luminance 0.892). ink #16202E on bg = 14.7:1 (>=7:1 AAA body). ink-soft #5A6575 on bg = 5.3:1 (>=4.5:1 AA). white #FFFFFF on primary #9E2A2B = 7.4:1 (>=4.5:1 AA, CTA labels safe); white on primary-dark #7A1F22 is even higher. primary #9E2A2B on bg = 6.7:1 (>=3:1 for large/UI). secondary navy #20304A on bg ~10:1 and brass accent #C29B45 reserved for non-text decorative use and on dark surfaces.
